notes:
Segment ministries-f covers: Health & Family Welfare (+ Health Research/ICMR), AYUSH, Education (+ School Education & Literacy, Higher Education), Women & Child Development, Social Justice & Empowerment (+ Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities), Tribal Affairs, Minority Affairs, Labour & Employment, and Skill Development & Entrepreneurship — 9 ministries / 6 constituent departments, ~107 subordinate/autonomous/statutory bodies and CPSEs (including all 27 AIIMS by name, individually, per instructions; IITs/IIMs/NITs/Central Universities as 4 aggregate entities with full name lists in each entity's `notes`), 53 named political and bureaucratic positions, and ~119 formal-power relations.

KNOWN GAPS / LOW-CONFIDENCE AREAS (flagged per-position/entity with confidence:"low" and notes; summarised here):
1. Bureaucratic reshuffle churn: India had an unusually large secretary-level bureaucratic reshuffle in July-August 2026 (following the Dharmendra Pradhan resignation / "Cockroach" protests over exam irregularities). Most Group-F Secretary names here come from a single non-official aggregator (sarkaritel.com, directory dated 2026-08-26) cross-checked against PIB/news for Health, Higher Education, Social Justice, Skill Development and Tribal Affairs; Minority Affairs and Labour & Employment secretary names (Srivatsa Krishna; Chandra Bhushan Kumar) are NOT independently cross-checked beyond that one directory and should be treated as medium/low confidence pending a primary-source (PIB/DoPT order) check.
2. Ministry of Education: the cabsec.gov.in official portfolio list (as on 23.06.2026) still names Dharmendra Pradhan as Education Minister, but he resigned on 2026-07-25 amid nationwide student protests over exam irregularities; Pralhad Joshi has held ADDITIONAL CHARGE of Education since then alongside his existing portfolios. As of the 2026-09-25 as-of date no successor with full/independent charge had been announced; a Cabinet reshuffle was rumoured around a 23-24 September 2026 "Chintan Shivir" but not confirmed. This entity's holder is therefore marked acting:true and should be re-checked after any September/October 2026 reshuffle.
3. Agency/PSU head names NOT confirmed for 2025-2026 (marked confidence:"low", holder either omitted or flagged as a possibly-stale recollection in notes): DGHS Director General, DCGI, NMC Chairperson, NBEMS President, NHA CEO, NACO DG, NCDC Director, CGHS DG, HLL Lifecare CMD, KVS Commissioner, NVS Commissioner, NTA Director General, EPFO Central PF Commissioner, ESIC Director General, NCSK Chairperson holder is Wikipedia-sourced only. These need a fresh PIB/official-site check before publication.
4. FSSAI Chairperson/CEO (Punya Salila Srivastava / Rajit Punhani) and NCERT Director, UGC Chairman, CBSE Chairperson, NIOS Chairman sourced only from Wikipedia article body text (not a dedicated "who's who" page), confidence medium — worth a primary-source spot check.
5. WebSearch quota was exhausted mid-session (shared session-wide budget); remaining research relied on WebFetch, curl, and the Wikipedia parse/query API, which is why the later ministries in this file (Tribal, Minority, Labour, Skill) have proportionally more low-confidence agency-head positions than Health/Education.
6. Aggregate entities (IITs, IIMs, NITs, Central Universities, AIIMS) use 2026-09-25 Wikipedia snapshots for membership lists; a small number of newly "announced"/"proposed" institutions (e.g. AIIMS Manipur, AIIMS Karnataka, AIIMS Kerala, AIIMS Nagaki) are not yet operational and are marked as such in their descriptions.
7. Central Waqf Council's legal basis now sits under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 — a major 2025 legal change to Waqf governance; this segment did not research downstream structural changes (e.g. non-Muslim member composition changes) in detail beyond noting the amendment.
8. Budget figures were intentionally omitted throughout (per SCHEMA.md, budget numbers are owned by the union-budget segment).
9. Council of Ministers portfolio data is anchored to the official cabsec.gov.in PDF "as on 23.06.2026" cross-checked against news for the Group-F ministers/MoS specifically; it was NOT re-verified line-by-line for non-Group-F portfolios mentioned only incidentally (e.g. a minister's "also holds X" notes).

entities.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
entities.description: Runs India's public-health policy, disease control, medical education regulation and health insurance programmes (Ayushman Bharat), through two departments: Health & Family Welfare, and Health Research.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Health and Family Welfare
entities.description: The main administrative department of the health ministry: public health programmes, hospitals, medical education regulation (via NMC/NBEMS), drug regulation (CDSCO) and health insurance (NHA).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Health Research
entities.description: Coordinates biomedical research policy and administers the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR); the Secretary, DHR is ex-officio Director-General of ICMR.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; created 2007

entities.name: Directorate General of Health Services
entities.description: The technical wing of the health ministry: runs central government hospitals/institutes, medical stores depots and public-health advisory functions, headed by the Director General of Health Services.

entities.name: Indian Council of Medical Research
entities.description: India's apex biomedical research body, running ~30 national research institutes on TB, malaria, cancer, nutrition and other health priorities; funded through the Department of Health Research.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society (1949, successor to the 1911 Indian Research Fund Association)

entities.name: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
entities.description: India's national regulator for pharmaceuticals, medical devices and cosmetics — approves new drugs/devices, sets standards and runs post-market surveillance, headed by the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI).
entities.legalBasis: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940

entities.name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.description: Statutory food-safety regulator: sets food standards, licenses food businesses and enforces the Food Safety and Standards Act through State/UT food safety officers.
entities.legalBasis: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006

entities.name: National Medical Commission
entities.description: Regulates medical education and practitioners in modern (allopathic) medicine: accredits medical colleges, licenses doctors and oversees NEET-based admissions; replaced the Medical Council of India in 2020.
entities.legalBasis: National Medical Commission Act, 2019

entities.name: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences
entities.description: Conducts postgraduate medical entrance/exit exams (NEET-PG, NEET-SS, FMGE) and awards the DNB/DrNB postgraduate medical qualifications, in parallel to university-based medical postgraduate education.

entities.name: National Health Authority
entities.description: Implements Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY), India's flagship public health-insurance scheme covering hospitalisation for economically vulnerable families, and the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society, 2019

entities.name: National AIDS Control Organisation
entities.description: Runs India's HIV/AIDS prevention and control programme through State AIDS Control Societies, blood-safety surveillance and antiretroviral treatment centres.

entities.name: National Centre for Disease Control
entities.description: India's lead public-health institute for epidemiology and communicable-disease surveillance and outbreak response, operating under DGHS with branches across the country.

entities.name: Central Government Health Scheme
entities.description: Provides healthcare to serving and retired central government employees and other eligible beneficiaries through wellness centres in 80+ cities.

entities.name: HLL Lifecare Limited
entities.description: Central public-sector healthcare-products manufacturer (condoms, contraceptives, surgical sutures, blood bags) and operator of the Amrit low-cost-medicine pharmacy chain; a long-pending disinvestment has not been completed.

entities.name: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare
entities.description: Apex training and research institute for health administrators and public-health managers, and a WHO collaborating centre.

entities.description: Promotes and regulates India's traditional systems of medicine — Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy — including their education, research councils and pharmacopoeia standards.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; carved out of Health Ministry as independent ministry 2014

entities.name: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine and Homoeopathy
entities.description: Sets and publishes official quality/pharmacopoeial standards for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy drugs, and administers their pharmacovigilance.

entities.name: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
entities.description: Apex body for Ayurveda research, running a network of national institutes and regional research centres.

entities.name: Central Council for Research in Unani Medicine
entities.description: Apex body for research in Unani medicine.

entities.name: Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy
entities.description: Apex body for research in Homoeopathy.

entities.name: Central Council for Research in Yoga and Naturopathy
entities.description: Apex body for research in Yoga and Naturopathy.

entities.name: Central Council for Research in Siddha
entities.description: Apex body for research in Siddha medicine.

entities.name: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine
entities.description: Regulates Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Sowa-Rigpa medical education and practitioners (accreditation, curricula, central registers); replaced the Central Council of Indian Medicine in 2021.
entities.legalBasis: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine Act, 2020

entities.name: National Commission for Homoeopathy
entities.description: Regulates homoeopathic medical education and practitioners; replaced the Central Council of Homoeopathy in 2021.
entities.legalBasis: National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020

entities.name: Ministry of Education
aliases: formerly Ministry of Human Resource Development
entities.description: Sets school and higher-education policy for India (curriculum frameworks, NEP 2020 implementation) through two departments — School Education & Literacy, and Higher Education — and regulates entrance exams, universities and technical institutes via UGC, AICTE, NCERT, NTA and others.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961 (renamed from Ministry of Human Resource Development in 2020)

entities.name: Department of School Education and Literacy
entities.description: Administers school education policy, mid-day meals, teacher education, and boards/bodies such as CBSE, NCERT, NCTE, KVS and NVS.

entities.name: Department of Higher Education
entities.description: Administers university and technical-education policy and funding, and bodies such as UGC, AICTE, NTA, IITs, IIMs, NITs and central universities.

entities.name: National Council of Educational Research and Training
entities.description: Develops the national school curriculum framework and textbooks, and conducts the National Talent Search Examination; also houses the National Council for Teacher Education secretariat.

entities.name: National Council for Teacher Education
entities.description: Regulates teacher-education institutions and programmes nationally — norms, recognition and standards for teacher training courses.
entities.legalBasis: National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993

entities.name: Central Board of Secondary Education
entities.description: India's largest school examination board, affiliating over 27,000 schools in India and abroad and conducting Class 10/12 board exams.

entities.name: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan
entities.description: Runs the ~1,250-school Kendriya Vidyalaya chain for children of central-government transferable employees (plus three schools abroad), one of the world's largest school chains.

entities.name: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
entities.description: Runs the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya system of ~650 free, fully-residential schools for academically talented children mostly from rural areas, one per district.

entities.name: National Institute of Open Schooling
entities.description: The world's largest open-schooling system, offering secondary/senior-secondary and vocational certification outside the formal school system through study centres in India and abroad.

entities.name: University Grants Commission
entities.description: Coordinates, funds and sets standards for university education in India, recognises universities and disburses grants and doctoral fellowships.
entities.legalBasis: University Grants Commission Act, 1956

entities.name: All India Council for Technical Education
entities.description: National regulator for technical, management, pharmacy and architecture education — approves and monitors AICTE-affiliated colleges and courses.
entities.legalBasis: All India Council for Technical Education Act, 1987

entities.name: National Testing Agency
entities.description: Conducts national entrance examinations for higher education (JEE Main, NEET-UG, UGC-NET, CUET and others); stopped conducting recruitment exams from 2025 after repeated paper-leak controversies.

entities.name: National Assessment and Accreditation Council
entities.description: Assesses and accredits Indian higher-education institutions on an eight-grade scale; in Feb 2025 the CBI arrested its chairman and several inspection-committee members in a bribery-for-accreditation scandal, after which NAAC suspended implicated assessors and reviewed hundreds of past assessments.

entities.name: National Institutional Ranking Framework
entities.description: Annual methodology and ranking exercise (not a standalone body) run by the Ministry of Education / National Board of Accreditation to rank Indian higher-education institutions across 11+ categories.

entities.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
entities.description: Runs India's women's-welfare and child-protection policy and schemes: anganwadi nutrition services (Poshan/ICDS), adoption regulation, child protection, and women's safety and empowerment programmes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Central Adoption Resource Authority

entities.name: National Institute of Public Cooperation and Child Development

entities.name: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh
entities.description: Provides micro-credit to poor women, mainly through NGOs/SHG-federation intermediaries, for income-generation activities.

entities.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
entities.description: Runs welfare, protection and economic-empowerment policy for Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, senior citizens, Safai Karamcharis and persons with disabilities, through two departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
entities.description: Handles welfare and development schemes for Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, senior citizens and Safai Karamcharis.

entities.name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; department created 2012

entities.name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation

entities.name: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation
entities.description: Government-owned non-profit corporation providing concessional finance for self-employment and skill development of persons from Other Backward Classes and denotified/nomadic tribes.

entities.name: National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation
entities.description: Government-owned corporation providing concessional finance and self-employment/rehabilitation support for Safai Karamcharis (sanitation workers), manual scavengers and their dependants.

entities.description: Training and research institute on 'social defence' issues — drug-demand reduction, elder care, and welfare of persons in need of care and protection.

entities.name: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation
entities.description: Runs commemorative, scholarship and welfare schemes in memory of B. R. Ambedkar, including international/national Ambedkar award schemes and the Mahaparinirvan Diwas observance.

entities.name: Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities
entities.description: Quasi-judicial office safeguarding the rights of persons with disabilities and adjudicating individual grievances under the disability-rights law; historically held ex officio by the DEPwD Secretary.
entities.legalBasis: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016

entities.name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
entities.description: Nodal ministry for welfare and development of Scheduled Tribes — education (EMRS), livelihoods and minor-forest-produce marketing (TRIFED), and concessional finance (NSTFDC).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; created as separate ministry 1999

entities.name: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation
entities.description: Apex government-owned corporation providing concessional finance and skill upgradation support for the economic development of Scheduled Tribes, channelised through State Channelizing Agencies.

entities.name: Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India
entities.description: National apex cooperative body for marketing tribal minor forest produce and handicrafts (via the 'Tribes India' brand and Van Dhan Yojana), and for fair-price procurement support to tribal gatherers.

entities.name: National Education Society for Tribal Students
entities.description: Society that manages the Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) — fully residential CBSE-affiliated schools for Scheduled Tribe students, targeting one EMRS per block with ≥50% ST population and ≥20,000 tribal persons.

entities.name: National Tribal Research Institute
entities.description: Apex research institute for tribal affairs, coordinating a network of State Tribal Research Institutes on tribal culture, ethnography and policy research.

entities.name: Ministry of Minority Affairs
entities.description: Nodal ministry for welfare, education and economic-empowerment schemes for India's notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains), and administers Waqf and Haj matters.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; created as separate ministry 2006

entities.name: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation
entities.description: Government-owned non-profit corporation providing concessional finance for self-employment and income-generation activities for people from notified minority communities.

entities.name: Central Waqf Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body to the Union Government on Waqf-Board administration and proper management of Waqf (Islamic charitable-endowment) properties across State Waqf Boards.
entities.legalBasis: Waqf Act, 1995, as amended by the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025

entities.name: Haj Committee of India
entities.description: Statutory body organising and facilitating the annual Haj pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia for Indian Muslims, acting as nodal agency for State Haj Committees.
entities.legalBasis: Haj Committee Act, 2002

entities.name: Maulana Azad Education Foundation
entities.description: Registered society running scholarship and educational-infrastructure schemes for educationally backward minority communities.

entities.name: Ministry of Labour and Employment
entities.description: Sets labour law and social-security policy (the four consolidated Labour Codes), and runs employees' provident fund and health-insurance schemes, mines safety regulation and industrial-relations machinery.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
entities.description: Administers India's mandatory retirement provident-fund, pension and insurance schemes for organised-sector employees (firms with 20+ workers), through the Central Board of Trustees; among the world's largest social-security organisations by membership.
entities.legalBasis: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 (now folded into the Code on Social Security, 2020)

entities.name: Employees' State Insurance Corporation
entities.description: Administers India's health-insurance and cash-benefit social-security scheme for organised-sector workers below a wage ceiling, running its own network of ESIC hospitals, dispensaries and medical colleges.
entities.legalBasis: Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948

entities.name: Directorate General of Employment
entities.description: Compiles national employment-market information and runs the National Career Service portal connecting job-seekers, employers and skilling/career-counselling services.

entities.name: Directorate General of Mines Safety
entities.description: Regulates occupational safety, health and welfare of workers in coal, metalliferous and oil mines under the Mines Act, 1952; headquartered in Dhanbad.
entities.legalBasis: Mines Act, 1952

entities.name: Office of the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central)
entities.description: Central enforcement machinery for labour laws (minimum wages, industrial disputes, contract labour) in central-sphere establishments, and chief conciliation authority for central-sphere industrial disputes.

entities.name: V. V. Giri National Labour Institute
entities.description: Apex labour-research, training and policy institute (formerly the Central Labour Institute), named after former President V. V. Giri.

entities.name: Labour Bureau
entities.description: Statistical wing of the ministry, compiling India's labour-market data — Consumer Price Index for Industrial/Agricultural/Rural Workers, employment-unemployment surveys and wage-rate indices.

entities.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
entities.description: Runs India's vocational-training and skilling policy (Skill India Mission), industrial training institutes, apprenticeship regulation and entrepreneurship-promotion programmes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; created as separate ministry 2014

entities.name: National Skill Development Corporation
entities.description: Not-for-profit public-private-partnership company (51% private, 49% government-held) that funds and catalyses private-sector vocational-training capacity, sector skill councils and skilling partnerships.

entities.name: National Council for Vocational Education and Training
entities.description: Regulates vocational-education and skill-training institutions and awarding bodies, formed in 2018 by merging the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) and National Skill Development Agency (NSDA).

entities.name: Directorate General of Training
entities.description: Runs India's public Industrial Training Institute (ITI) system, apprenticeship-training scheme, and vocational-instructor training (Craftsmen/Apprentices Training Schemes).

entities.name: National Institute for Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development
entities.description: Apex training and research body for entrepreneurship development and small-business promotion, running Entrepreneurship Development Programmes nationally.

entities.name: National Institute of Ayurveda
entities.description: Deemed-to-be university (De-novo category, since 2020) for Ayurveda teaching, clinical training and research; one of AYUSH's flagship national institutes.

entities.name: Central Board for Workers Education
entities.description: Runs worker-education, trade-union leadership and labour-literacy training programmes for organised- and unorganised-sector workers through regional/sub-regional centres.

entities.name: Indian Institutes of Skills
entities.description: A small, growing network of flagship, industry-partnered vocational-training institutes (modelled loosely on the IIT/IIM brand) — the first opened in Mumbai (with Tata Group) in 2022, followed by further IIS in Kanpur, Ahmedabad, Bhubaneswar and Faridabad.
